items.CONTENT:
MEASUREMENT_DEFAULT_RELATIVE_EPSILON is fixed at 0.01 for relative metrics to expose an existing upstream numerical assumption without changing v0.1 behavior.

MeasurementStage is Inputs, SignedDifference, MetricOutput.

MeasurementInputRef.runtimeId mirrors mutation-sensitive Image::id() for local disambiguation and is explicitly not a source revision or provenance identifier.

MeasurementSamplingSpec separately records DataWindowCoordinates for interactive correspondence and CenteredImageExtents for materialized comparison, including independent reference offsets.

MeasurementSpec retains optional candidate/reference, sampling policy, alpha policy, channel group, region, channel mask, terminal metric, and fixed relative epsilon.

ViewSpec is presentation-only state: tonemap, exposure, offset, gamma, brightness limit, softness, and clip-to-LDR.

MeasurementLineage is explicitly a live description of one comparison lineage, not a stored MeasurementResult.

measurementSamplingSpec computes interactiveReferenceOffset = candidateDataWindow.min - referenceDataWindow.min and materializedReferenceOffset = (referenceDataWindow.size - candidateDataWindow.size)/2.

Metric formulas are C-R, |C-R|, (C-R)^2, |C-R|/(R+epsilon), and (C-R)^2/(R^2+epsilon), with epsilon from MeasurementMetricSpec.
ViewSpec contract says presentation changes must not mutate MeasurementSpec, MeasurementStage, or numerical semantics exposed by a stage.

Stage projection uses no reference at Inputs; SignedDifference uses reference with effective Error metric; MetricOutput uses reference with the retained terminal metric.

Upstream traversal is MetricOutput -> SignedDifference -> Inputs; downstream traversal reverses that order. No transition exists beyond either endpoint.

measurementCorrespondencePathsAgree compares the two stored reference offsets rather than assuming equivalence.

describeMeasurementLineage exposes candidate/reference runtime identities, both correspondence transforms and agreement status, sample/alpha policy, channels, region, metric formula, and presentation-only view state.

setImage, setReference, and setMetric reset the exposed stage to MetricOutput when a measurement reference exists, otherwise Inputs, then synchronize the effective stage projection.

setMeasurementStage prevents non-Inputs stages without a measurement reference.

showUpstream/showDownstream traverse only through the explicit MeasurementStage predecessor/successor functions and refuse traversal when no reference or no adjacent stage exists.

measurementLineage constructs a live MeasurementLineage from current image/reference names and runtime IDs, data-window sampling, channel group/mask, crop region, terminal metric, stage, and view settings.

syncMeasurementStage keeps MeasurementSpec selection separate from effective render/statistics fields: moving upstream changes the exposed projection without destroying selected terminal reference or metric.
ImageViewer gains measurement-stage label plus Show Upstream and Resume Downstream buttons and an updateMeasurementUi method.

The measurement UI is placed beside existing metric controls and is described in source as exposing already-existing comparison stages rather than introducing a new comparison engine.

Upstream and Resume callbacks call ImageCanvas stage traversal, update measurement UI, and redraw.

updateMeasurementUi derives labels/tooltips from live MeasurementLineage, disables impossible traversal, and explicitly describes downstream resume as stage traversal using retained live specification, not reconstruction from a stored recipe.

The semantic-anchor fixture constructs candidate/reference identities, RGB mask, a bounded region, RelativeSquaredError terminal metric, and deliberately mismatched candidate/reference data-window coordinates.

Fixture requires interactive correspondence offset (100,40), materialized offset (0,0), and explicit non-agreement of the two correspondence paths.

Fixture traverses MetricOutput -> SignedDifference -> Inputs -> SignedDifference -> MetricOutput while requiring MeasurementSpec stability and stage-specific effective metric/reference projections.

Fixture mutates exposure, offset, gamma, and tonemap and requires both stage and MeasurementSpec to remain unchanged.
On all assertions passing the test prints a correspondence-divergence + round-trip + view-isolation OK message and returns success; failed requires exit nonzero.

CMake enables testing, builds tev_measurement_semantics_test from tests/MeasurementSemanticsTest.cpp, and registers it with add_test.

CMake defines tev_measurement_acceptance as an ALL custom target whose command directly executes tev_measurement_semantics_test, making the semantic anchor part of the default build graph.

MSVC builds the semantic test with /utf-8 to match the main target portability rule.

CI triggers on pushes to master and pull requests targeting master.

CI build jobs invoke the default build graph: target all on Linux/macOS and ALL_BUILD on Windows, then separately check that the tev program starts.

GitHub Actions run 31630457443 for the exact frozen commit is completed with conclusion success.

The run exposes eight jobs across Linux, macOS, and Windows variants; every job and every retrieved Build step concluded success.
